CP-B: workflow explicitly includes merge_group -> triggered.
CP-C: only pull_request in workflow, scenario is merge_group -> Pending.
Push baseline: on push branches main, push to main -> triggered.
pull_request types [opened] but action synchronize -> no trigger.
pull_request types [opened, synchronize], action opened -> triggered.
merge_group types [checks_requested] but action synchronize -> no trigger.
List-form on: [push, pull_request], scenario pull_request -> triggered.
CP-F: branches+paths, only branch matches (docs-only change) -> no trigger.
CP-F complement: branches+paths, only path matches (base release/2.x) -> no trigger.
CP-G: ordered negation src/**, !src/generated/**, src/generated/keep.ts -> keep.ts re-included, triggered.
CP-H: commit message contains [skip ci] -> workflow skip, Pending.
branches-ignore [main], PR base is main -> branch mismatch, no trigger.
paths-ignore [docs/**], only docs changed -> path mismatch, no trigger.
CP-K: push 1500 commits > 1000 -> path filter treated as triggered.
CP-L: diff 3500 files, first-3000 list unconfirmed -> UNKNOWN.
CP-D: workflow triggered, required job if: false -> SKIPPED_SUCCESS.
CP-E: aggregator if always() with skipped upstream -> ELIGIBLE.
CP-I: two workflows declare the same job context 'tests' -> AMBIGUOUS.
CP-J: required check 'integration' has no provider job -> Pending.
CP-I complement: two jobs in one workflow share context 'tests' -> AMBIGUOUS.
Upstream if:false skipped; downstream with no if inherits default success() gate -> SKIPPED.
Downstream of ELIGIBLE upstream with supported context if -> CONDITIONAL_AFTER_NEEDS, reportable.
Fail-closed bundle: unsupported if -> UNKNOWN, missing need -> INVALID, needs cycle -> INVALID, external source -> UNKNOWN; one healthy job stays reportable.
